states.claim: profile points to the EXIF StringInfo obtained from the image profile; if absent, the function returns without further object state.
exif points to the byte storage of the EXIF profile datum.
directory is set to an interior byte address within the exif storage region at the first IFD offset.
directory_stack entries store directory pointers, entry indices, and tag offsets that are restored when a directory level is popped.
q is set to an interior byte address within the exif storage region for the current directory entry.
exif_resources is a splay tree used to record visited directory-entry addresses q; a repeated q causes the loop to break.
p is set to q+8 when the entry value fits inline in the directory entry.
p is set to an interior byte address within the exif storage region at dir_offset when the value is stored out of line.
value is initialized to NULL before the format switch.
value may be allocated as a new string buffer for BYTE/UNDEFINED and STRING formats.
value may be allocated by the EXIFMultipleValues/EXIFMultipleFractions macros via AcquireString(buffer).
value is released with DestroyString after being used to set an image property.
key is allocated as a new string from property and later released with DestroyString.
exif_resources is destroyed before the function returns.
directory_stack entries are populated with directory pointers derived from exif+offset and exif+tag_offset1 for nested IFD traversal.

values.claim: tag_bytes[] maps EXIF format codes to component byte widths: index 0->0, 1->1, 2->1, 3->2, 4->4, 5->8, 6->1, 7->1, 8->2, 9->4, 10->8, 11->4, 12->8; number_bytes = components * tag_bytes[format].
number_bytes is computed as (size_t)components*tag_bytes[format]; the check number_bytes < components rejects overflow where components is ssize_t.
If number_bytes <= 4, p points to q+8 (inline value in the 12-byte directory entry); otherwise p is set from an offset read at q+8.
For out-of-line values, dir_offset must be nonnegative and < length, and (size_t)dir_offset+number_bytes must not overflow and must be <= length before p=exif+dir_offset.
values.evidence:
L638: if ((dir_offset < 0) || (size_t) dir_offset >= length)
L640: if (((size_t) dir_offset+number_bytes) < (size_t) dir_offset)
L642: if (((size_t) dir_offset+number_bytes) > length)
L644: p=(unsigned char *) (exif+dir_offset);

values.claim: Before formatting, p must satisfy p >= exif and p <= exif+length-tag_bytes[format].
values.evidence: L652: if ((p < exif) || (p > (exif+length-tag_bytes[format])))

values.claim: For EXIF_FMT_STRING/default, p must satisfy p >= exif and p <= exif+length-number_bytes.
values.evidence: L731: if ((p < exif) || (p > (exif+length-number_bytes)))

values.claim: For BYTE/UNDEFINED and STRING/default, value is allocated with AcquireQuantumMemory(number_bytes+1, sizeof(*value)) when ~(size_t)number_bytes >= 1, and value[number_bytes] is set to '\0'.
EXIFMultipleValues/EXIFMultipleFractions initialize p1=p and advance p1 by size per component for components iterations, so p1 reaches p+size*components.

L42: p1+=size; \

L62: for (component=0; component < components; component++) \
L68: p1+=size; \

When matching by name, tag is set to (size_t)EXIFTag[i].tag for the matching description.
values.evidence: L520: tag=(size_t) EXIFTag[i].tag;
